title: New Ticket form shows the signed-in agent as owner, but the ticket is saved Unassigned
label: BUG vs ZOHO
date: TAVI 7 Nov 2026 01:58 · Zoho 7 Nov 2026 (live, form opened and cancelled, nothing saved)
env: TAVI staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging, owner ndc-staging-owner) · Dept QA AS6 Dept B, no rules · Zoho Desk org techsolutionsegypt (Enterprise trial, admin)

panels.caption: TAVI: Tickets → Create Ticket, before Save — Ticket Owner pre-filled with ndc-staging-owner
TAVI: the saved ticket #1200 — Ticket Owner Unassigned
Zoho: Tickets → Add Ticket — Ticket Owner pre-filled with the signed-in agent (closed with Cancel, not submitted)

rows: Default Ticket Owner on the form
The Add Ticket form opens with Ticket Owner = the signed-in agent (seen).
The Create Ticket form opens with Ticket Owner = the signed-in user (ndc-staging-owner). Same as Zoho.
The ticket keeps the owner shown on the form (expected; Zoho was not submitted, so its saved result was not seen).

Saving without touching the field sends no owner (the POST has no owner field) and #1200 is saved Unassigned. In a department with a round-robin create rule the ticket went to the next agent instead (#1199 → Dev Team 2), although the form showed ndc-staging-owner.
